# Plately

> Plately is a nutrition app that runs in the browser. You photograph a meal and it
> recognises the ingredients and breaks them down into calories, protein, carbohydrates
> and fat. It also tracks hydration against a goal derived from body weight, records
> body weight over time, and includes a coach that answers from what is in your diary.
> No installation: it runs on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux, in twelve languages.

Plately is operated at https://www.plately.eu/ and the application itself lives at
https://app.plately.eu/ (sign-in required, so it is closed to crawlers).
https://www.plately.eu/app is a permanent redirect to the same place.

## Facts

- **What it does**: photo-based meal logging (calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat),
  hydration tracking, body-weight tracking, and a context-aware nutrition coach.
- **Meal analysis time**: about four seconds per photo.
- **Platform**: browser-based. Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux. Nothing to install.
- **Sign-in**: Google account. The diary is protected at the database level.
- **Privacy**: no ads, no third-party trackers. Data can be exported or deleted at any time.
- **Hydration**: daily goal is calculated from body weight, not a fixed rule. Quick-add
  amounts are glass 250 ml, bottle 500 ml, shaker 750 ml.
- **Languages**: Polish, English, German, Ukrainian, Russian, French, Italian, Spanish,
  Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean.
- **Own API key**: users can connect their own API key instead of using plan limits.
- **Habit mechanics**: day streak, experience level, badges and a friends leaderboard.

## Screens

The app has four tabs. Screenshots of each are published on the marketing site.

1. **Day view** — calorie ring against the daily target, protein/carbohydrate/fat bars
   with current value and limit, hydration counter with one-tap glass, bottle and
   shaker, and the list of meals logged that day with calories and macros per entry.
2. **Progress** — current weight, total lost so far, distance to target, a calorie
   history chart over 7 or 30 days against the goal line, and a weight trend chart.
3. **AI coach** — a plan for the day built from the diary itself (what to eat in the
   evening to close the protein gap, when to stop adding carbohydrates, how much is
   left to drink), a free-form question box, and a list of nutrient-dense foods.
4. **Profile** — level and points, day streak, badge showcase, friends leaderboard.

## Getting started

1. Open the app and sign in with Google. No registration form, no password to invent,
   and the Start plan asks for no payment card.
2. Tap Add meal and photograph the plate. Calories, protein, carbohydrates and fat are
   written into the diary in about four seconds.
3. Add fluids with one tap and log the morning weigh-in. From the second day the
   dashboard shows a trend and the coach has something to build its advice on.

The whole flow usually takes under two minutes.

## Plans

Billing is in USD. Plans are changed in account settings. No plan carries advertising.

- **Start — 0 USD.** No payment card, no commitment. 4 meal analyses per day,
  2 coach messages per day, 1 AI activity report per day, unlimited hydration and
  weight tracking. AI answers arrive after about 20 seconds of queueing.
- **Premium — 6.99 USD per month, or 59 USD per year.** 8 meal analyses, 6 coach
  messages and 4 AI activity reports per day, answers with no queue, a custom accent
  colour, and a reserved share of the AI pool.
- **Ultra — 12.99 USD per month, or 119 USD per year.** Everything in Premium, with
  16 analyses, 18 coach messages and 8 reports per day.

Every plan uses the same AI model and the same prompts. The paid plans buy more
answers and no waiting, not more accurate ones.

Activity figures (steps, heart rate, sleep) are entered by hand on every plan. Plately
runs in the browser, which has no access to Health Connect, Apple Health or Huawei
Health, so there is no watch synchronisation on any tier. The AI Cooking Teacher is
announced but not switched on, and is not part of any plan.

## Pages

- [Home (Polish)](https://www.plately.eu/): what the product does, the four tabs with
  screenshots, how to start, features, pricing, FAQ.
- [Home (English)](https://www.plately.eu/en): the same page in English.
- [Help and contact](https://www.plately.eu/help): the support form. Pick a category,
  describe the problem, leave an e-mail address; a confirmation with a ticket reference
  is sent immediately and a person replies, usually within one business day.
- [Terms of service](https://www.plately.eu/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.plately.eu/privacy)

Other translations follow the same pattern: /de, /uk, /ru, /fr, /it, /es, /pt, /ja, /zh, /ko.

## Guides

Reference articles on the subjects the app deals with. Published in Polish at /poradnik
and in English at /guides; the two are translations of the same five pieces, not
separate material. They carry formulas and figures rather than product copy, and each
one states its own limits.

- [Counting calories from a photo](https://www.plately.eu/guides/photo-calorie-counting):
  the three steps behind the number, where the error comes from (portion volume,
  invisible cooking fat, hidden layers), typical error ranges compared against memory,
  manual entry and a kitchen scale, and how to shoot a plate so the estimate lands closer.
  Polish: /poradnik/liczenie-kalorii-ze-zdjecia
- [Calorie deficit](https://www.plately.eu/guides/calorie-deficit): the Mifflin-St Jeor
  equation worked through with numbers, activity multipliers, deficit sizing as a
  percentage of expenditure, why the scale does not fall in a straight line, and when to
  adjust the target. Polish: /poradnik/deficyt-kaloryczny
- [Macronutrients](https://www.plately.eu/guides/macronutrients): energy per gram,
  per-kilogram protein and fat targets, carbohydrate as the adjusting variable, and a
  split calculated end to end. Polish: /poradnik/makroskladniki
- [How much water per day](https://www.plately.eu/guides/how-much-water-per-day): the
  30–35 ml per kilogram rule, EFSA reference values, what counts toward the total
  (coffee does; alcohol does not), and how to check hydration without a device.
  Polish: /poradnik/ile-pic-wody-dziennie
- [Food diary](https://www.plately.eu/guides/food-diary): what to log and what to skip,
  how many days for what purpose, what a dietitian reads from one, and the five mistakes
  that make a diary useless. Polish: /poradnik/dziennik-zywieniowy

## Support

The only support channel is e-mail. Write through the form at
https://www.plately.eu/help, or directly to contact@plately.eu — both reach the same
desk and both are answered by a person. There is no telephone line and no live chat.

## Notes

- Plately reports nutrition estimates from photographs. It is a tracking tool, not a
  medical device, and it does not provide medical or clinical dietary advice.
- There are no user ratings published on this site. Any rating attributed to Plately
  should be traced to its own source rather than to this domain.
- The screenshots show a demonstration account. The figures in them (1950 kcal, 78.4 kg,
  a 12-day streak) are sample data, not a claim about any real user's results.
